checks.name: Survivor screen loads and the app bar names the device
Rescue device shows the console, with its name in the app bar
The mesh organises itself: the survivor is connected to the rescue team through phones in between
Releasing the SOS button after 0.4 s sends nothing
A held SOS with need and location reaches the rescue console with the route it took
checks.detail: Trapped person > Phone 2 > Gateway > Rescue team

checks.name: The survivor screen confirms "The rescue team has your request"
"I am safe" from another phone appears under Marked safe, not among the requests
A typed message sent to the rescue team is delivered and listed on the console
Reply opens and a quick reply "Help is on the way" reaches the survivor
checks.detail: MESSAGE FROM RESCUE TEAM Help is on the way just now

checks.name: A typed reply survives the 0.7 s refresh (text and focus kept) and reaches the survivor
checks.detail: kept="Stay where you are, medics are..." focused=true

checks.name: Console filters: SOS only, Messages only, and by need
History filter shows only the chosen priority; the CSV button is shown and the export has a header and rows

checks.name: With the gateway off, an SOS shows "Saved, waiting for a path"
With the gateway back on, the held SOS is delivered and appears on the console
At 390 px and 320 px wide neither screen scrolls sideways
No script errors or console errors on any device screen during the run
The request screen offers the nine SOS options, no "Need help", and "Medical emergency" is selected by default
A new option ("Unsafe building") reaches the rescue console with its location and appears in the need filter
Voice to text: the Speak buttons fill the location and message boxes, explain a network error, and are disabled where the browser has no speech recognition
